patch_proto_files: patch generated protobuf _pb2.py files to add extra fields like to_dict and to_frozen
patch_pb2_pyi_files: patch protobuf .pyi stub files to add type hints for frozen config classes
create_frozen_class: create a frozen read-only wrapper class from a protobuf message class

frozen_conf_usage: use _FrozenConf to create immutable config objects from protobuf messages with field access
